title: Parmesan Crusted Chicken Sheet Pan Dinner
reject_reason: Parmesan/breadcrumb chicken with red potatoes and green beans on a sheet pan is the same chicken+potato+parmesan sheet-pan dinner as live parmesan-garlic-sheet-pan-chicken-potatoes (3 of 4 axes, breadcrumb-crust nuance only); parmesan-crusted chicken also covered by accepted copycat-longhorn-parmesan-crusted-chicken.
